reader_summary.overview: with Nicole Forsgren (@nicolefv). It's not useful to talk about what happens in one isolated team or successful company. But can we break the false dichotomy of performance vs. speed; is it possible to have it all? Forsgren (co-founder and CEO at DevOps Research and Assessment - DORA; PhD in Management Information Systems; formerly at IBM) and Humble (co-founder and CTO at DORA.
